title: Validity and Reliability of Vietnamese Version of 17items-Hamilton Depression Rating Scale
brief_summary: this reseach examines the reliability and validity of 17 items- Hamilton Depression rating scale in Vietnamese population, which has been commonly used in clinical depression practice and study.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients accept paticipating in reasearch

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients don't answer full HRDS
study_population: Patients are diagnosied depressive disorder at Psychiatric and neurologic department at Unoversity of medicine and pharmacy Hochiminh city hospital
